bookInfo.name: New History of the Five Dynasties

title.zh: 卷五十八 新五代史考第一
title.en: Volume 58 Examination on the New Five Dynasties :
title.raw: 卷五十八 新五代史考第一 Volume 58 Examination on the New Five Dynasties :

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，五代禮樂文章，吾無取焉。

translations.literal: Alas, as for the rites, music, and writings of the Five Dynasties, I have nothing to adopt from them.
translations.idiomatic: Alas, I find nothing in the rites, music, or literary culture of the Five Dynasties that I would wish to take as a model.

sentences.zh: 其後世有欲知之者，不可以遺也。

translations.literal: Yet those in later ages who wish to know them must not have them cast aside.
translations.idiomatic: Still, later generations who wish to understand that era must not be left without a record.

translations.literal: Therefore I compose the "Examination of the Director of Heaven and the Director of Regions."
translations.idiomatic: I therefore wrote the "Examination of the Director of Heaven and the Director of Regions."

translations.literal: ○ Examination of the Director of Heaven, Part One
translations.idiomatic: ○ Part One: Examination of the Director of Heaven

translations.literal: The Director of Heaven oversees the representations of the sun, moon, stars, and constellations.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Heaven was charged with observing the sun, moon, stars, and constellations.

sentences.zh: 周天一歲，四時，二十四氣，七十二候，行十日十二辰，以為歷。

translations.literal: The circuit of heaven constitutes one year, with four seasons, twenty-four qi-periods, seventy-two hou-periods, proceeding through the ten-day week and twelve double-hours, to serve as the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: One circuit of heaven marks a year, divided into four seasons, twenty-four qi, seventy-two hou, and measured by the ten-day week and twelve double-hours—this is what the calendar records.

translations.literal: Whoever carefully observes their changes uses them for prognostication.
translations.idiomatic: Careful observation of their variations yields material for divination.

sentences.zh: 占者，非常之兆也，以驗吉兇，以求天意，以覺人事，其術藏於有司。

translations.literal: Prognostication means portents out of the ordinary, by which to verify fortune and misfortune, to seek Heaven's intent, and to awaken human affairs; its techniques are kept among the official specialists.
translations.idiomatic: Divination reads extraordinary signs to test good and ill fortune, discern Heaven's will, and guide human affairs; its methods were entrusted to the appropriate offices.

sentences.zh: 歷者，有常之數也，以推寒暑，以先天道，以勉人事，其法信於天下。

translations.literal: The calendar consists of fixed numbers, by which to calculate cold and heat, to anticipate the Way of Heaven, and to encourage human affairs; its methods are trusted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The calendar rests on fixed numerical cycles to project cold and heat, anticipate the heavenly pattern, and regulate human affairs; its methods commanded universal trust.

sentences.zh: 術有時而用，法不可一日而差。

translations.literal: Techniques are employed when the occasion demands, but the calendar standards must not err by a single day.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomical techniques may be applied as needed, yet calendrical rules must not deviate even for one day.

sentences.zh: 差之毫厘，則亂天人之序，乖百事之時，蓋有國之所重也。

translations.literal: An error of a hair's breadth disrupts the order of Heaven and man and throws off the seasons of the hundred affairs—thus it is what a state holds in the highest regard.
translations.idiomatic: A deviation no wider than a hair's breadth can throw Heaven and humanity out of order and upset the timing of every affair of state—which is why rulers treated it with such gravity.

sentences.zh: 然自堯命羲、和見於《書》，中星閏余，略存其大法。

translations.literal: Yet from the time Yao charged Xi and He, as recorded in the Documents, the cardinal stars and intercalary remainders preserve the outline of the great method.
translations.idiomatic: Still, from Yao's appointment of Xi and He in the Documents, the cardinal stars and intercalary remainders preserve at least the broad outline of the original method.

sentences.zh: 而三代中間千有餘歲，遺文曠廢，《六經》無所述。

translations.literal: But across the more than a thousand years between the Three Dynasties, the transmitted texts were abandoned and lost, and the Six Classics offer no account.
translations.idiomatic: Yet across the thousand-odd years of the Three Dynasties, the transmitted records fell into neglect, and the Six Classics say nothing on the subject.

sentences.zh: 而孔子之徒，亦未嘗道也。

translations.literal: Nor did Confucius and his followers ever discuss it.
translations.idiomatic: Nor did Confucius and his disciples ever address it.

sentences.zh: 至於後世，其學一出於陰陽之家，其事則重，其學則末。

translations.literal: As for later ages, the learning all issued from the school of yin and yang; the matter was weighty, but the learning was peripheral.
translations.idiomatic: In later times the subject passed entirely into the hands of the yin-yang specialists: the office remained weighty, but the learning had become a minor craft.

sentences.zh: 夫天人之際，遠哉微矣，而使一藝之士，布算積分，上求數千萬歲之前，必得甲子朔旦夜半冬至，而日、月、五星皆會於子，謂之上元，以為歷始。

translations.literal: The boundary between Heaven and man is distant and subtle indeed, yet craftsmen of a single art spread out counting-sticks and accumulated fractions, seeking upward tens of millions of years into the past until they obtain the jiazi year when new moon, dawn, midnight, and winter solstice coincide, with sun, moon, and the five planets all meeting at the zi position—this they call the supreme origin and take as the calendar's beginning.
translations.idiomatic: The boundary between Heaven and humanity is immeasurably remote and subtle, yet technicians of a single craft would lay out counting-rods and accumulated fractions, reaching back tens of millions of years until they fixed a jiazi year in which new moon, dawn, midnight, and winter solstice aligned, with sun, moon, and the five planets all gathered at zi—the "supreme origin" taken as the calendar's starting point.

sentences.zh: 蓋自漢而後，其說始詳見於世，其源流所自止於如此。

translations.literal: From the Han onward this doctrine first appeared in full in the world, and the source from which it sprang goes no further than this.
translations.idiomatic: Only from the Han onward did this doctrine appear in full; its origins extend no further back than this.

translations.literal: Can this truly be the method of Yao, Shun, and the Three Dynasties?
translations.idiomatic: Can this really have been the method of Yao, Shun, and the Three Dynasties?

translations.literal: None of it can be examined and verified.
translations.idiomatic: None of it can be verified by evidence.

sentences.zh: 然自是以來，歷家之術，雖世多不同，而未始不本於此。

translations.literal: Yet from that time onward, although calendrical methods differed from age to age, they never ceased to be rooted in this.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from that time on, though calendrical schools differed from one generation to the next, none ever departed from this foundation.

sentences.zh: 五代之初，因唐之故，用《崇玄曆》。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Five Dynasties, following Tang precedent, they used the Chongxuan Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset of the Five Dynasties period, the court continued Tang practice and adopted the Chongxuan Calendar.

sentences.zh: 至晉高祖時，司天監馬重績始更造新歷，不復推古上元甲子冬至七曜之會，而起唐天寶十四載乙未為上元，用正月雨水為氣首。

translations.literal: By the time of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, the Director of Heaven Ma Chongji first devised a new calendar, no longer projecting back to the ancient supreme origin of jiazi, winter solstice, and the conjunction of the seven luminaries, but instead taking the yiwei year of the fourteenth year of Tianbao of Tang as the supreme origin and using Rain Water in the first month as the head of the qi-periods.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jin Emperor Gaozu, Director of Heaven Ma Chongji devised a new calendar that abandoned retrojection to the ancient supreme origin of jiazi, winter solstice, and the seven luminaries in conjunction, and instead took yiwei, the fourteenth year of Tang's Tianbao era, as the supreme origin, with Rain Water in the first month as the year's qi-head.

sentences.zh: 初，唐建中時，術者曹士蒍始變古法，以顯慶五年為上元，雨水為歲首，號《符天曆》。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Jianzhong period of Tang, the technician Cao Shibian first altered the ancient method, taking the fifth year of Xianqing as the supreme origin and Rain Water as the year's head, calling it the Futian Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during Tang's Jianzhong era, the technician Cao Shibian had first broken with ancient practice, taking the fifth year of Xianqing as the supreme origin and Rain Water as the year's beginning—the calendar known as the Futian Calendar.

sentences.zh: 然世謂之小歷，只行於民間。

translations.literal: Yet the world called it the minor calendar, and it circulated only among the people.
translations.idiomatic: The world called it the "minor calendar," and it circulated only among commoners.

sentences.zh: 而重績乃用以為法，遂施於朝廷，賜號《調元曆》。

translations.literal: Chongji then adopted it as the standard method, and it was applied at court, receiving the title Tiaoyuan Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Chongji adopted it as the official standard, and the court promulgated it under the title Tiaoyuan Calendar.

sentences.zh: 然行之五年，輒差不可用，而復用《崇玄曆》。

translations.literal: Yet after five years in use it immediately fell out of alignment and could not be used, and the Chongxuan Calendar was restored.
translations.idiomatic: After only five years it had drifted out of alignment and was abandoned, and the Chongxuan Calendar was restored.

sentences.zh: 周廣順中，國子博士王處訥私撰《明玄曆》於家。

translations.literal: In the Guangshun period of Zhou, the National University academician Wang Chune privately composed the Mingxuan Calendar at home.
translations.idiomatic: During Later Zhou's Guangshun era, National University academician Wang Chune privately composed the Mingxuan Calendar at home.

sentences.zh: 民間又有《萬分曆》，而蜀有《永昌曆》、《正象曆》，南唐有《齊政曆》。

translations.literal: Among the people there was also the Wanfen Calendar, while Shu had the Yongchang and Zhengxiang calendars, and Southern Tang had the Qizheng Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners also used the Wanfen Calendar; Shu had the Yongchang and Zhengxiang calendars; Southern Tang had the Qizheng Calendar.

sentences.zh: 五代之際，歷家可考見者止於此。

translations.literal: At the time of the Five Dynasties, the calendrical schools that can be examined extend no further than this.
translations.idiomatic: For the Five Dynasties period, the calendrical traditions that can be documented end here.

sentences.zh: 而《調元曆》法既非古，《明玄》又止藏其家，《萬分》止行於民間，其法皆不足紀。

translations.literal: The Tiaoyuan Calendar's method was already unorthodox; the Mingxuan was kept only in a private household; the Wanfen circulated only among the people—their methods are all unworthy of record.
translations.idiomatic: The Tiaoyuan method was already unorthodox; the Mingxuan never left Wang's household; the Wanfen never left the folk sphere—none of their methods merit recording.

sentences.zh: 而《永昌》《正象》《齊政曆》，皆止用於其國，今亦亡，不復見。

translations.literal: The Yongchang, Zhengxiang, and Qizheng calendars were each used only within their own states; today they too are lost and no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongchang, Zhengxiang, and Qizheng calendars were each confined to its own state; all are now lost and no longer extant.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，外伐僭叛，內修法度。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, he campaigned abroad against usurpers and rebels and reformed laws and institutions at home.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong came to the throne, he campaigned abroad against rebel regimes while reforming laws and institutions at home.

sentences.zh: 端明殿學士王樸，通於歷數，乃詔樸撰定。

translations.literal: The Hanlin academician Wang Pu, versed in calendrical reckoning, was ordered to compose and fix the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Wang Pu, who was expert in calendrical reckoning, received an imperial order to draft a new calendar.

translations.literal: After more than a year, Pu memorialized, saying:
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year, Pu submitted a memorial that read:

sentences.zh: ◎臣聞聖人之作也，在乎知天人之變者也。

translations.literal: ◎ Your servant has heard that what the sage establishes lies in knowing the transformations of Heaven and man.
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Your servant has heard that what the sage establishes rests on understanding the transformations of Heaven and humanity.

sentences.zh: 人情之動，則可以言知之；

translations.literal: The movements of human sentiment can be known through words;
translations.idiomatic: The movements of human affairs can be grasped through language;

sentences.zh: 天道之動，則當以數知之。

translations.literal: the movements of the Heavenly Way must be known through numbers.
translations.idiomatic: but the movements of the Heavenly Way must be grasped through numbers.

sentences.zh: 數之為用也，聖人以之觀天道焉。

translations.literal: In the use of numbers, the sage thereby observes the Heavenly Way.
translations.idiomatic: It is through number that the sage observes the Heavenly Way.

translations.literal: Years, months, days, and hours are thereby constituted;
translations.idiomatic: Years, months, days, and hours take their form thereby;

translations.literal: yin and yang, cold and heat, are thereby regulated;
translations.idiomatic: yin and yang, cold and heat, are regulated thereby;

translations.literal: the governance of the four quarters proceeds thereby.
translations.idiomatic: and the governance of the four quarters proceeds thereby.

sentences.zh: 夫為國家者，履端立極，必體其元；

translations.literal: One who governs a state, in taking up the year's beginning and establishing the pole, must embody its origin;
translations.idiomatic: Whoever governs a state, in inaugurating the year and establishing the cosmic pole, must embody its origin;

translations.literal: in promulgating policies and assessing achievements, must follow its year;
translations.idiomatic: in promulgating policy and assessing achievement, must follow the year's cycle;

translations.literal: in moving rites and raising music, must correct its new moon;
translations.idiomatic: in performing rites and music, must align the new moon;

translations.literal: the three farmers and the hundred crafts must follow its seasons;
translations.idiomatic: farmers and artisans alike must follow its seasons;

translations.literal: the five punishments and nine punitive expeditions must follow its qi;
translations.idiomatic: punishments and punitive campaigns must follow its qi;

translations.literal: the myriad affairs that are undertaken must follow its sun and moon.
translations.idiomatic: every affair of state must follow its sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 是以聖人受命，必治歷數。

translations.literal: Therefore when the sage receives the Mandate, he must regulate the calendar and numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when the sage receives the Mandate, he must set the calendar in order.

sentences.zh: 故五紀有常度，庶征有常應，正朔行之於天下也。

translations.literal: Thus the five chronologies have their fixed measures, the various signs have their fixed responses, and the correct new moon is practiced throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the five chronologies hold their fixed measures, the various portents their fixed responses, and the correct calendar is promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 自唐之季，凡歷數朝，亂日失天，垂將百載，天之歷數，汨陳而已。

translations.literal: From the end of Tang through several dynasties, days were disordered and Heaven was lost; for nearly a hundred years Heaven's calendar and numbers were merely cast aside in confusion.
translations.idiomatic: From the end of Tang through successive dynasties, the calendar fell into chaos and Heaven's order was lost; for nearly a century the heavenly reckoning lay in ruins.

sentences.zh: 陛下順考古道，寅畏上天，咨詢庶官，振舉墜典。

translations.literal: Your Majesty follows and examines the ancient Way, stands in reverent awe of High Heaven, consults the various officials, and raises up fallen statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has followed the ancient Way, stood in reverent awe of Heaven, consulted his officials, and revived fallen institutions.

translations.literal: Your servant, though not capable, how dare he not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Though your servant lacks ability, how could I dare refuse the imperial command?

sentences.zh: 乃包萬象以為法，齊七政以立元，測圭箭以候氣，審朓朒以定朔，明九道以步月，校遲疾以推星，考黃道之斜正，辨天勢之升降，而交蝕詳焉。

translations.literal: I have therefore embraced the myriad phenomena to form the method, aligned the seven regulators to establish the origin, measured the gnomon and clepsydra to observe the qi, examined the tiao and tuo to fix the new moon, clarified the nine paths to pace the moon, calibrated slow and fast motion to project the stars, investigated the obliquity and rectitude of the Yellow Path, distinguished the rising and falling of Heaven's disposition, and made eclipses precise.
translations.idiomatic: I have embraced the myriad phenomena as method, aligned the seven regulators to establish the origin, measured the gnomon and clepsydra to observe the qi, examined lunar elongation to fix the new moon, clarified the nine paths to track the moon, calibrated planetary motion to project the stars, investigated the obliquity of the ecliptic, distinguished the rising and falling of celestial disposition, and rendered eclipses precise.

translations.literal: The Way established for Heaven is called yin and yang.
translations.idiomatic: The Way established for Heaven is yin and yang.

sentences.zh: 陰陽各有數，合則化成矣。

translations.literal: Yin and yang each have their numbers; when combined, transformation and completion ensue.
translations.idiomatic: Yin and yang each have their numbers; combined, they produce transformation and completion.

sentences.zh: 陽之策三十六，陰之策二十四。

translations.literal: The yang tally is thirty-six, the yin tally twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: The yang tally is thirty-six; the yin tally, twenty-four.

sentences.zh: 奇偶相命，兩陽三陰，同得七十二。

translations.literal: Odd and even are paired by command; two yang and three yin alike yield seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: Odd and even are paired by command: two yang and three yin alike yield seventy-two.

translations.literal: When alike, the numbers of yin and yang combine.
translations.idiomatic: When they match, the numbers of yin and yang unite.

translations.literal: Seventy-two is the number of transformation and completion.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-two is the number of transformation and completion.

translations.literal: Transformation and completion are called the numbers of the Five Phases.
translations.idiomatic: Transformation and completion constitute the numbers of the Five Phases.

translations.literal: Multiply by five to obtain the period number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by five to obtain the period number.

sentences.zh: 過之者謂之氣盈，不及者謂之朔虛。

translations.literal: What exceeds is called qi surplus; what falls short is called new-moon deficit.
translations.idiomatic: What exceeds is called qi surplus; what falls short is called new-moon deficit.

sentences.zh: 至於應變分用，無所不通。

translations.literal: As for responding to change and apportioning use, there is nothing it does not reach.
translations.idiomatic: In responding to change and apportioning use, nothing lies beyond its reach.

translations.literal: Therefore seventy-two serves as the canonical method.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore seventy-two serves as the canonical method.

translations.literal: The canonical is the method in constant use.
translations.idiomatic: The canonical method is that in constant use.

sentences.zh: 百者，數之節也，隨法進退，不失舊位，故謂之通法。

translations.literal: One hundred is the node of numbers; advancing and retreating with the method without losing the original position—hence it is called the universal method.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred is the node of numbers; advancing and retreating with the method without losing position—hence the universal method.

sentences.zh: 以通法進經法，得七千二百，謂之統法。

translations.literal: Advancing the canonical method by the universal method yields seven thousand two hundred—this is called the comprehensive method.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing the canonical by the universal method yields 7,200—the comprehensive method.

sentences.zh: 自元入經，先用此法，統歷之諸法也。

translations.literal: From the origin entering the canonical, this method is applied first—it governs all methods of the comprehensive calendar.
translations.idiomatic: From the origin through the canonical, this method is applied first—it governs all methods of the comprehensive calendar.

sentences.zh: 以通法進統法，得七十二萬。

translations.literal: Advancing the comprehensive method by the universal method yields seven hundred twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing the comprehensive by the universal method yields 720,000.

sentences.zh: 氣朔之下，收分必盡，謂之全率。

translations.literal: Beneath qi and new moon, when collected fractions are fully exhausted, this is called the complete rate.
translations.idiomatic: Beneath qi and new moon, when collected fractions are fully exhausted, this is the complete rate.

sentences.zh: 以通法進全率，得七千二百萬，謂之大率，而元紀生焉。

translations.literal: Advancing the complete rate by the universal method yields seventy-two million—this is called the great rate, and from it the origin and era are born.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing the complete rate by the universal method yields 72 million—the great rate, from which the origin and era are born.

translations.literal: The origin means year, month, day, and hour are all jiazi;
translations.idiomatic: The origin is when year, month, day, and hour are all jiazi;

translations.literal: sun, moon, and five planets all meet at zi;
translations.idiomatic: sun, moon, and the five planets all gather at zi;

sentences.zh: 當盈縮、先後之中，所謂七政齊矣。

translations.literal: standing at the mean of expansion-contraction and precedence-lag—this is what is called the seven regulators aligned.
translations.idiomatic: standing at the mean of expansion and contraction, precedence and lag—what is called the seven regulators in alignment.

sentences.zh: 古者植圭於陽城，以其近洛也。

translations.literal: In antiquity the gnomon was planted at Yangcheng because it was near the Luo River.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the gnomon was erected at Yangcheng because it lay near the Luo.

sentences.zh: 蓋尚慊其中，乃在洛之東偏。

translations.literal: Yet still dissatisfied with its centrality, it was placed on the eastern margin of the Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Still dissatisfied with its centrality, they placed it on the Luo's eastern margin.

sentences.zh: 開元十二年，遣使天下候影，南距林邑，北距橫野，中得浚儀之嶽臺，應南北弦，居地之中。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kaiyuan, envoys were sent throughout the realm to observe shadows; south to Linyi, north to Hengye; at the center the Yuetai of Junyi was obtained, corresponding to the north-south chord and occupying the middle of the earth.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan 12, envoys were dispatched empire-wide to observe shadows, from Linyi in the south to Hengye in the north; at the center they found the Yuetai at Junyi, on the north-south meridian at the earth's midpoint.

translations.literal: When Great Zhou established the state, it fixed the capital at Bian.
translations.idiomatic: When Great Zhou established its state, it fixed the capital at Bian.

sentences.zh: 樹圭置箭，測嶽臺晷漏，以為中數。

translations.literal: The gnomon was set up and the clepsydra arrows placed; the sundial and water-clock of the Yuetai were measured to serve as the central numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The gnomon was erected and clepsydra arrows set; the Yuetai sundial and water-clock were measured to establish the central reckoning.

sentences.zh: 晷漏正，則日之所至，氣之所應，得之矣。

translations.literal: When the sundial and water-clock are correct, where the sun reaches and where the qi responds are thereby obtained.
translations.idiomatic: When sundial and water-clock are correct, the sun's position and the qi's response can be determined.

translations.literal: Both sun and moon have expansion and contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Both sun and moon exhibit expansion and contraction.

translations.literal: When the sun expands and the moon contracts, the median comes late and the new moon follows.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun expands and the moon contracts, the median lags and the new moon follows.

translations.literal: When the moon expands and the sun contracts, the median comes early and the new moon precedes.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon expands and the sun contracts, the median comes early and the new moon precedes.

sentences.zh: 自古朓朒之法，率皆平行之數；

translations.literal: From antiquity the methods for tiao and tuo have generally all been uniform-motion numbers;
translations.idiomatic: From antiquity, methods for lunar elongation relied on uniform-motion numbers;

sentences.zh: 入歷既有前次，而又衰稍不倫。

translations.literal: entering the calendar already had prior sequences, yet the gradations of increase and decrease were inconsistent.
translations.idiomatic: though entering the calendar already had prior sequences, the gradations of increase and decrease were inconsistent.

translations.literal: The old method of the Huangji was circuitous and hard to use.
translations.idiomatic: The old Huangji method was circuitous and impractical.

sentences.zh: 降及諸歷，則疏遠而多失。

translations.literal: Down to the various calendars, they were remote and full of errors.
translations.idiomatic: Later calendars were crude and prone to error.

sentences.zh: 今以月離朓朒，隨歷校定，日躔朓朒，臨用加減。

translations.literal: Now the moon's departure in tiao and tuo is calibrated according to the calendar; the sun's motion in tiao and tuo receives additions and subtractions when applied.
translations.idiomatic: Now lunar elongation is calibrated against the calendar, and solar motion receives additions and subtractions at the point of application.

translations.literal: What is obtained is the day fixed by entering departure.
translations.idiomatic: What is obtained is the day fixed by entering departure.

translations.literal: Within one day it is divided into nine limits.
translations.idiomatic: A single day is divided into nine limits.

translations.literal: Each limit has its increase and decrease; the gradations of waning and waxing have their order.
translations.idiomatic: Each limit has its increase and decrease; the gradations follow a coherent order.

translations.literal: The method for tiao and tuo can be called precise.
translations.idiomatic: The method for lunar elongation may truly be called precise.

translations.literal: The Red Path is Heaven's girding belt.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial equator is Heaven's girding belt.

sentences.zh: 其勢圜而平，紀宿度之常數焉。

translations.literal: Its form is circular and level, recording the constant numbers of lodge degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Circular and level in form, it records the constant lodge degrees.

translations.literal: The Yellow Path is the sun's track.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic is the sun's track.

sentences.zh: 其半在赤道內，半在赤道外，去極二十四度。

translations.literal: Half lies within the Red Path, half outside, twenty-four degrees from the pole.
translations.idiomatic: Half lies within the equator, half outside, twenty-four degrees from the pole.

translations.literal: When near the Red Path, its form is oblique;
translations.idiomatic: When near the equator, its course is oblique;

translations.literal: when far from the Red Path, its form is straight.
translations.idiomatic: when far from the equator, its course is straight.

translations.literal: When oblique, the sun's daily motion should be slow;
translations.idiomatic: When oblique, the sun's daily motion should be slow;

translations.literal: when straight, the sun's daily motion should be fast.
translations.idiomatic: when straight, the sun's daily motion should be fast.

sentences.zh: 故二分前後加其度，二至前後減其度。

translations.literal: Therefore before and after the two equinoxes add to the degrees; before and after the two solstices subtract from the degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly, degrees are added before and after the equinoxes and subtracted before and after the solstices.

translations.literal: The nine paths are the moon's track.
translations.idiomatic: The nine paths are the moon's orbit.

sentences.zh: 其半在黃道內，半在黃道外，去極遠六度。

translations.literal: Half lies within the Yellow Path, half outside, six degrees farther from the pole.
translations.idiomatic: Half lies within the ecliptic, half outside, six degrees farther from the pole.

translations.literal: Emerging from the Yellow Path is called the primary crossing;
translations.idiomatic: Emerging from the ecliptic is called the primary crossing;

translations.literal: entering the Yellow Path is called the median crossing.
translations.idiomatic: entering the ecliptic is called the median crossing.

sentences.zh: 若正交在秋分之宿，中交在春分之宿，則比黃道益斜。

translations.literal: If the primary crossing is at the lodge of the autumn equinox and the median crossing at the lodge of the spring equinox, then compared with the Yellow Path it is more oblique.
translations.idiomatic: If the primary crossing falls at the autumn-equinox lodge and the median at the spring-equinox lodge, the orbit is more oblique than the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 若正交在春分之宿，中交在秋分之宿，則比黃道反直。

translations.literal: If the primary crossing is at the lodge of the spring equinox and the median crossing at the lodge of the autumn equinox, then compared with the Yellow Path it is conversely straight.
translations.idiomatic: If the primary crossing falls at the spring-equinox lodge and the median at the autumn-equinox lodge, the orbit is conversely straighter than the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 若正交、中交在二至之宿，則其勢差斜。

translations.literal: If primary and median crossings are at the lodges of the two solstices, then its form is moderately oblique.
translations.idiomatic: If both crossings fall at the solstice lodges, the orbit is moderately oblique.

sentences.zh: 故校去二至二分遠近，以考斜正，乃得加減之數。

translations.literal: Therefore calibrate the distance from the two solstices and two equinoxes to examine obliquity and rectitude, and thereby obtain the numbers for addition and subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: By calibrating distance from the solstices and equinoxes to test obliquity and rectitude, one obtains the numbers for addition and subtraction.

sentences.zh: 自古雖有九道之說，蓋亦知而未詳，徒有祖述之文，而無推步之用。

translations.literal: From antiquity although there was talk of the nine paths, they knew but did not elaborate; there were only texts handed down by tradition, without computational application.
translations.idiomatic: Although the nine paths were discussed from antiquity, the tradition knew them only in outline—texts handed down by rote, without computational use.

sentences.zh: 今以黃道一周，分為八節；

translations.literal: Now the Yellow Path's full circuit is divided into eight nodes;
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic's full circuit is now divided into eight nodes;

translations.literal: within one node it is divided into nine paths;
translations.idiomatic: each node is divided into nine paths;

sentences.zh: 盡七十二道，而使日月無所隱其斜正之勢焉。

translations.literal: completing seventy-two paths, so that sun and moon cannot hide their oblique and straight dispositions.
translations.idiomatic: yielding seventy-two paths in all, so that sun and moon conceal nothing of their oblique and straight courses.

translations.literal: The method of the nine paths can be called clear.
translations.idiomatic: The method of the nine paths may truly be called clear.

sentences.zh: 星之行也，近日而疾，遠日而遲。

translations.literal: In a star's motion, when near the sun it is fast, when far from the sun it is slow.
translations.idiomatic: A planet moves swiftly near the sun and slowly when far from it.

translations.literal: Extremely far from the sun, its momentum is exhausted and it stations.
translations.idiomatic: At greatest distance from the sun its momentum is spent and it stations.

sentences.zh: 自古諸歷，分段失實，隆降無準；

translations.literal: From antiquity the various calendars divided segments with unreal results, and their rise and fall had no standard;
translations.idiomatic: Ancient calendars divided segments inaccurately, with no standard for rise and fall;

sentences.zh: 今日行分尚多，次日便留；

translations.literal: today's motion-fraction is still large, yet the next day it stations;
translations.idiomatic: one day its motion-fraction is still large, the next day it stations;

sentences.zh: 自留而退，惟用平行，仍以入段行度為入歷之數；

translations.literal: from stationing it retreats, using only uniform motion, still taking the segment's motion-degrees as the number for entering the calendar;
translations.idiomatic: from station it retreats using only uniform motion, still taking segment motion-degrees as the calendar entry number;

translations.literal: none of this accords with the fundamental principle, and thus reaches contradiction.
translations.idiomatic: none of this accords with fundamental principle, and contradiction follows.

sentences.zh: 今校逐日行分積，以為變段。

translations.literal: Now daily motion-fractions are accumulated in sequence to form variable segments.
translations.idiomatic: Daily motion-fractions are now accumulated in sequence to form variable segments.

sentences.zh: 然後自疾而漸遲，勢盡而留。

translations.literal: Then from swift it gradually becomes slow, and when momentum is exhausted it stations.
translations.idiomatic: Then from swift it gradually slows until momentum is spent and it stations.

sentences.zh: 自留而行，亦積微而後多。

translations.literal: From stationing it proceeds, again accumulating minutely before becoming much.
translations.idiomatic: From station it proceeds again, accumulating minutely before becoming great.

sentences.zh: 別立諸段變曆，以推變差，俾諸段變差，際會相合。

translations.literal: Separate variable segments and variable calendars are established to project variable differences, so that the variable differences of the various segments meet in alignment.
translations.idiomatic: Separate variable segments and variable calendars project the variable differences so that segment differences align in meeting.

sentences.zh: 星之遲疾，可得而知之矣。

translations.literal: The slow and swift motion of stars can thereby be known.
translations.idiomatic: Planetary slow and swift motion can thereby be known.

sentences.zh: 自古相傳，皆謂去交十五度以下，則日月有蝕。

translations.literal: Handed down from antiquity, all say that within fifteen degrees of departure from crossing, sun and moon will eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Tradition held that within fifteen degrees of nodal departure, sun and moon would eclipse.

sentences.zh: 殊不知日月之相掩，與暗虛之所射，其理有異。

translations.literal: They did not know that the mutual masking of sun and moon and the casting of the dark void have different principles.
translations.idiomatic: They did not grasp that mutual masking of sun and moon and casting of the dark void follow different principles.

sentences.zh: 今以日月徑度之大小，校去交之遠近，以黃道之斜正，天勢之升降，度仰視、旁視之分數，則交虧得其實矣。

translations.literal: Now by comparing the great and small of sun and moon diameters, calibrating nearness and distance from crossing, the obliquity and rectitude of the Yellow Path, the rise and fall of Heaven's disposition, and the fractional degrees of overhead and side viewing, the loss at crossing is thereby obtained in reality.
translations.idiomatic: By comparing sun and moon diameters, calibrating nodal distance, ecliptic obliquity, celestial disposition, and overhead versus side-view fractions, eclipse magnitude is obtained in reality.

translations.idiomatic: Your servant finds no earlier text on the head and tail of the eclipse spirit.

translations.idiomatic: Recently, minor techniques of the Director of Heaven and diviners, unable to grasp the whole, devised a method of equal connection.

sentences.zh: 蓋從假用，以求徑捷，於是乎交有逆行之數。

translations.literal: It was adopted provisionally for convenience, seeking a direct shortcut; thus crossing acquired a number for retrograde motion.
translations.idiomatic: Adopted provisionally for convenience, it gave crossing a retrograde number.

translations.idiomatic: All of these are now cut away.

translations.idiomatic: Multiply first day's motion fractional parts; divide by canonical method; before noon add, after noon subtract from added-time Yellow Path degrees—for noon solar degrees.

translations.idiomatic: Set heavenly median qi before-noon fractional parts as noon entry expansion calendar day fractional parts.

translations.idiomatic: ◎ Dawn and dusk fractional parts

translations.literal: Each sets entry calendar fractional parts; multiply by that day's increase-decrease rate; as comprehensive method to one; increase or decrease the lower dawn fractional parts—for the sought dawn fixed fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set entry calendar fractional parts; multiply by increase-decrease rate; as comprehensive method to one; adjust lower dawn fractional parts for dawn fixed fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 用損加、益減其下昏分，即所求昏定分也。

translations.literal: Use decrease to add and increase to subtract the lower dusk fractional parts—for the sought dusk fixed fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Decrease to add and increase to subtract lower dusk fractional parts for dusk fixed fractional parts.

translations.literal: ◎ Day entry and exit double-hours and quarters
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Day entry and exit double-hours and quarters

sentences.zh: 置晨昏分，以一百八十加晨、減昏，為日出入分。

translations.literal: Set dawn and dusk fractional parts; add one hundred eighty to dawn and subtract from dusk for day entry-exit fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set dawn and dusk fractional parts; add 180 to dawn and subtract from dusk for day entry-exit fractional parts.

translations.literal: Each divide by the double-hour rule for double-hour numbers;
translations.idiomatic: Each divide by double-hour rule for double-hour numbers;

translations.literal: remainder filling canonical method for quarters;
translations.idiomatic: remainder filling canonical method for quarters;

sentences.zh: 命辰數子正算外，則日出入辰刻也。

translations.literal: count double-hour numbers from zi beyond the calculation—this is day entry-exit double-hours and quarters.
translations.idiomatic: count double-hours from zi beyond calculation—day entry-exit double-hours and quarters.

translations.literal: ◎ Day and night quarters
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Day and night quarters

translations.literal: Set day-entry fractional parts; subtract day-exit fractional parts for day fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set day-entry fractional parts; subtract day-exit for day fractional parts.

translations.literal: Use to subtract from comprehensive method for night fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from comprehensive method for night fractional parts.

translations.literal: Each fills canonical method for day and night quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Each fills canonical method for day and night quarters.

translations.idiomatic: ◎ Five night double-hours and quarters

sentences.zh: 置昏分，以辰則除，為辰數；

translations.literal: Set dusk fractional parts; divide by double-hour rule for double-hour numbers;
translations.idiomatic: Set dusk fractional parts; divide by double-hour rule for double-hour numbers;

translations.literal: divide by canonical method for quarter numbers.
translations.idiomatic: divide by canonical method for quarter numbers.

sentences.zh: 命辰數子正算外，即甲夜辰刻也。

translations.literal: Count double-hour numbers from zi beyond the calculation—this is the first night double-hours and quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Count from zi beyond calculation—the first night double-hours and quarters.

sentences.zh: 倍晨分，五約之，為更用分。

translations.literal: Double dawn fractional parts; divide by five for watch-use fractional parts.

translations.literal: Again divide by five for tally-use fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Again divide by five for tally-use fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 用累加甲夜，滿辰則為辰，滿經法為刻，即各得五夜辰刻也。

translations.literal: Add cumulatively to the first night; when full of double-hour rule for double-hours, full of canonical method for quarters—each yields the five nights' double-hours and quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Add cumulatively to first night; when full of double-hour rule for hours, full of canonical method for quarters—five nights' double-hours and quarters.

translations.idiomatic: Median stars at dusk and dawn

translations.literal: Set entry calendar fractional parts; multiply by that day's increase-decrease rate; as comprehensive method to one; increase or decrease the lower inner-outer numbers;
translations.idiomatic: Set entry calendar fractional parts; multiply by increase-decrease rate; as comprehensive method to one; adjust lower inner-outer numbers;

translations.literal: if insufficient to decrease, then reverse the decrease;
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient to decrease, reverse the decrease;

translations.literal: inner and outer alternate in naming—to obtain the sought Red Path inner-outer fixed number.

translations.idiomatic: ◎ Nine domains' distance-from-track numbers

translations.idiomatic: Set li distance north and south from Yuetai; extend through by 360 for paces.

translations.idiomatic: Divide by 1,756; north add, south subtract 2,513 for girdle-median number; with Red Path inner-outer fixed number, inner subtract outer add—for nine domains' distance-from-track number.

translations.idiomatic: Nine domains' median gnomon

sentences.zh: 置距軌數，二十五乘之，一百三十七除，為天用分。

translations.literal: Set distance-from-track number; multiply by 25; divide by 137 for heaven-use fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set distance-from-track number; multiply by 25; divide by 137 for heaven-use fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 置之，以二十二乘，六約之，用減四千，為晷法。

translations.literal: Set it; multiply by 22; divide by six; use to subtract 4,000 for gnomon method.
translations.idiomatic: Set it; multiply by 22; divide by six; subtract 4,000 for gnomon method.

sentences.zh: 又以天用分自相乘，如晷法而一，為地用分。

translations.literal: Again self-multiply heaven-use fractional parts; as gnomon method to one for earth-use fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Self-multiply heaven-use fractional parts; as gnomon method to one for earth-use fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 相從為晷分，分十為寸，即得其地中晷也。

translations.literal: Follow together for gnomon fractional parts; ten parts make one inch—this obtains that place's median gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: Follow together for gnomon fractional parts; ten parts make one inch—that place's median gnomon.

translations.literal: multiply by 263; divide by canonical method for clepsydra method.
translations.idiomatic: multiply by 263; divide by canonical method for clepsydra method.

translations.idiomatic: Extend track median above; set Red Path inner-outer below; subtract below from above; multiply remainder;

translations.literal: when full of clepsydra method, for clepsydra fractional parts.

translations.literal: Subtract from comprehensive method for dusk fractional parts.

translations.idiomatic: Set dawn and dusk fractional parts; each enter by Yuetai technique—for that place's day entry-exit, five nights, and dusk-dawn median stars.

translations.literal: ◎ Moon's departure entering the calendar
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Lunar departure: entering the calendar

sentences.zh: 置朔積，以離率去之，余滿統法為日，即天正常朔加時入歷也。

translations.literal: Set new-moon accumulation; remove by departure rate; remainder filling comprehensive method for days—this is the heavenly normal new moon's added-time entry calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Set new-moon accumulation, remove the departure rate, and take days as the remainder over the comprehensive method—the calendar entry at added time for the heavenly normal new moon.

sentences.zh: 累加象策，盈離策去之，即弦望及次朔入歷也。

translations.literal: Add cumulatively by image tally; when full remove by departure tally—this is first quarter, full moon, and successive new moon entering the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Add the image tally cumulatively, removing full departure tallies, to obtain calendar entries for quarters, full moons, and successive new moons.

translations.literal: ◎ Moon's departure in tiao and tuo
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Lunar departure: elongation correction

sentences.zh: 置入歷分，以日躔朓朒定數，朓減、朒加之，程節除之，為限數。

translations.literal: Set entry calendar fractional parts; with sun's motion tiao-tuo fixed number, tiao subtract and tuo add; divide by procedure interval for limit number.
translations.idiomatic: Set calendar-entry fractional parts; apply the sun's fixed elongation number—subtract for waning elongation, add for waxing—and divide by the procedure interval to obtain the limit number.

sentences.zh: 余乘所入限損益率，程節而一，用損益其限朓朒為定數。

translations.literal: Remainder multiplies the limit increase-decrease rate entered; divide by procedure interval; use to increase or decrease that limit's tiao-tuo for fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the remainder by the limit's increase-decrease rate, divide by the procedure interval, and adjust the limit elongation to obtain the fixed number.

translations.literal: ◎ Fixed days of new moon, quarter, and full moon
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Fixing the days of new moon, quarters, and full moon

sentences.zh: 各以日躔月離朓朒定數，朓減、朒加朔弦望常分，為定日。

translations.literal: Each uses sun's motion and moon's departure tiao-tuo fixed number; tiao subtract and tuo add to new-moon, quarter, and full-moon constant fractional parts—for fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: For each phase, apply the fixed solar and lunar elongation numbers—subtract for waning, add for waxing—to the constant fractional parts to obtain the fixed day.

sentences.zh: 定朔加時日入後，則進一日；

translations.literal: When fixed new moon's added-time day enters after, then advance one day;
translations.idiomatic: If the sun has already set at the computed time of the fixed new moon, advance the date by one day;

translations.literal: if crossing visibility at beginning, then do not advance.
translations.idiomatic: unless an eclipse is visible at its beginning—in which case do not advance.

sentences.zh: 弦望加時日未出，則退一日，日雖出有交見初亦如之。

translations.literal: When quarter or full moon added-time day has not risen, retreat one day; though sun has risen, if crossing visibility at beginning, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: For a quarter or full moon whose added time falls before sunrise, retreat one day; the same applies if an eclipse is visible at its beginning even when the sun has already risen.

translations.literal: When origin day has crossing, then fix by message.
translations.idiomatic: When the year's first day bears a crossing, fix the intercalation by the waxing-and-waning rule.

translations.literal: When fixed new moon and following new moon share stems alike, large;
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed new moon and the next new moon share the same celestial stem, the month is long;

translations.literal: when not alike, small;
translations.idiomatic: if they differ, it is short;

translations.literal: Without median qi, this is intercalary.
translations.idiomatic: A month without a median qi is intercalary.

translations.literal: New moon and full moon added-time solar degrees
translations.idiomatic: Solar longitude at added time for new and full moon

sentences.zh: 各置日躔入歷，以日躔月離朓朒定數，朓減、朒加之，為定朔加時入歷。

translations.literal: Each sets sun's motion entry calendar; with sun's motion and moon's departure tiao-tuo fixed number, tiao subtract and tuo add—for fixed new moon added-time entry calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Set the sun's calendar entry and adjust it with the fixed solar and lunar elongation numbers—subtract for waning, add for waxing—to obtain the calendar entry at fixed-new-moon added time.

sentences.zh: 以歷分乘其日損益率，統法而一，損益其下盈縮數，為定數。

translations.literal: Multiply calendar fractional parts by that day's increase-decrease rate; comprehensive method to one; increase or decrease the lower expansion-contraction number—for fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply calendar fractional parts by that day's increase-decrease rate, divide by the comprehensive method, and adjust the lower expansion-contraction figure to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 置定朔歷分，通法約之，以定數盈加、縮減之。

translations.literal: Set fixed new moon calendar fractional parts; reduce by universal method; with fixed number, expansion add and contraction subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed-new-moon calendar fractional parts, reduce by the universal method, and add for expansion or subtract for contraction according to the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 各命以冬夏至之宿算外，即所求也。

translations.literal: Each count from winter and summer solstice lodges beyond the calculation—this is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count lodge positions from the winter and summer solstice starting points to obtain the result sought.

translations.literal: Moon's departure entering crossing
translations.idiomatic: Lunar departure: entering the crossing

sentences.zh: 置朔積，以交率去之，余滿統法為日，即天正常朔入交泛日也。

translations.literal: Set new-moon accumulation; remove by crossing rate; remainder filling comprehensive method for days—this is heavenly normal new moon entering crossing general day.
translations.idiomatic: Set new-moon accumulation, remove the crossing rate, and take days as the remainder over the comprehensive method—the general crossing day for the heavenly normal new moon.

sentences.zh: 以望策累加之，盈交策去之，即望及次朔所入也。

translations.literal: Add cumulatively by full-moon tally; when full remove by crossing tally—this is what full moon and successive new moon enter.
translations.idiomatic: Add the full-moon tally cumulatively, removing full crossing tallies, to find entries for the full moon and successive new moons.

sentences.zh: 各以日躔朓朒定數，朓減、朒加之，為入交常日。

translations.literal: Each uses sun's motion tiao-tuo fixed number; tiao subtract and tuo add—for entering crossing constant day.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the sun's fixed elongation number—subtract for waning, add for waxing—to obtain the constant crossing day.

sentences.zh: 置月離朓朒定數，經法乘之，平離而一，朓減、朒加常分，即入交定日也。

translations.literal: Set moon's departure tiao-tuo fixed number; multiply by canonical method; level departure to one; tiao subtract and tuo add constant fractional parts—this is entering crossing fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: Set the lunar fixed elongation number, multiply by the canonical method, divide by level departure, and subtract or add to the constant fractional parts to obtain the fixed crossing day.

translations.literal: Yellow Path rectified-crossing lunar degree
translations.idiomatic: Ecliptic longitude at rectified crossing

sentences.zh: 統法通朔交定日，以二百五十四乘之，十九而一。

translations.literal: Extend comprehensive method through new-moon crossing fixed day; multiply by two hundred fifty-four; divide by nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: Extend fixed crossing days through the comprehensive method, multiply by 254, and divide by 19.

translations.literal: Again divide by comprehensive method for entering-crossing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Divide again by the comprehensive method to obtain crossing-entry degrees.

sentences.zh: 用減其朔加時日度，即朔前月離正交黃道宿度也。

translations.literal: Use to subtract from its new moon added-time solar degrees—this is before new moon moon's departure rectified-crossing Yellow Path lodge degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the new-moon added-time solar longitude to obtain the moon's ecliptic lodge position at rectified crossing before new moon.

translations.literal: ◎ Nine paths' lodge sequence
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Lodge sequence of the nine paths

translations.literal: Moon's departure exits and enters Yellow Path six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar departure crosses the ecliptic by six degrees.

translations.literal: Transformation follows the eight nodes; oblique and rectified differ.
translations.idiomatic: The variation follows the eight nodal points, with differing obliquity and alignment.

translations.literal: Therefore the moon has nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the moon's motion comprises nine paths.

translations.literal: Yellow Path's eight nodes each have nine limits.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the eight ecliptic nodal points has nine limits.

sentences.zh: 若正交起，八節後第一限之宿，為月行其節第一道。

translations.literal: If rectified crossing begins, the lodge of the first limit after the eight nodes is the moon's motion in that node's first path.
translations.idiomatic: From rectified crossing, the lodge of the first limit after each node marks the moon's first path in that node.

sentences.zh: 起第二限之宿，為月行其節第二道，即以所起限為正交後第一限。

translations.literal: Beginning the second limit's lodge is moon's motion in that node's second path; that limit begun serves as first limit after rectified crossing.
translations.idiomatic: The lodge where the second limit begins marks the second path, and that starting limit becomes the first limit after rectified crossing.

sentences.zh: 初率八，每限減一，盡九限，末率空。

translations.literal: Initial rate eight; each limit decreases by one; exhausting nine limits; final rate empty.
translations.idiomatic: The initial rate is eight, decreasing by one per limit through nine limits, with a final rate of zero.

sentences.zh: 又九限，初率空，每限增一，末率八，殷半交之宿。

translations.literal: Again nine limits; initial rate empty; each limit increases by one; final rate eight—approaching half-crossing's lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Nine more limits follow, rising from zero to eight and approaching the lodge of half crossing.

sentences.zh: 自後亦九限，初率八，每限減一，末率空。

translations.literal: From thereafter likewise nine limits; initial rate eight; each limit decreases by one; final rate empty.
translations.idiomatic: Another nine limits then descend from eight to zero in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 又九限，初率空，每限增一，末率八，復與黃道相會，謂之中交。

translations.literal: Again nine limits; initial rate empty; each limit increases by one; final rate eight; again meeting Yellow Path—this is called median crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Nine limits rise again from zero to eight until the path rejoins the ecliptic—the median crossing.

translations.literal: From median crossing to rectified crossing, it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The segment from median to rectified crossing follows the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 各置所入限度，以限率乘之，為泛差。

translations.literal: Each sets limit degrees entered; multiply by limit rate—for general difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the limit degrees entered and multiply by the limit rate to obtain the general difference.

sentences.zh: 其正交、中交前後各九限，以距二至之宿限數乘之。

translations.literal: Its rectified crossing and median crossing before and after nine limits each—multiply by limit number of lodges distant from two solstices.
translations.idiomatic: For the nine limits before and after rectified and median crossing, multiply by the solstice limit count.

sentences.zh: 半交前後各九限，以距二分之宿限數乘之：皆如經法而一，為黃道差。

translations.literal: Half-crossing before and after nine limits each—multiply by limit number of lodges distant from two equinoxes: all as canonical method to one—for Yellow Path difference.
translations.idiomatic: For the nine limits before and after half crossing, multiply by the equinox limit count; divide each by the canonical method to obtain the ecliptic difference.

sentences.zh: 在冬至之宿後，正交前後各九限為減，中交前後各九限為加。

translations.literal: After winter solstice's lodge, rectified crossing before and after nine limits are subtract; median crossing before and after nine limits are add.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter-solstice lodge, subtract for nine limits around rectified crossing and add for nine limits around median crossing.

sentences.zh: 在夏至之宿後，正交前後各九限為加，中交前後各九限為減。

translations.literal: After summer solstice's lodge, rectified crossing before and after nine limits are add; median crossing before and after nine limits are subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After the summer-solstice lodge, add for nine limits around rectified crossing and subtract for nine limits around median crossing.

sentences.zh: 凡月正交後出黃道外，中交後入黃道內。

translations.literal: In general, after moon's rectified crossing exit outside Yellow Path; after median crossing enter inside Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: In general, after rectified crossing the moon lies outside the ecliptic; after median crossing it lies within.

sentences.zh: 其半交前後各九限，在春分之宿後，出黃道外，秋分之宿後，入黃道內：皆以差為加；

translations.literal: Its half-crossing before and after nine limits: after spring equinox's lodge exit outside Yellow Path; after autumn equinox's lodge enter inside Yellow Path—all take difference as add;
translations.idiomatic: For nine limits around half crossing: after the spring-equinox lodge, exiting the ecliptic, and after the autumn-equinox lodge, entering within—all add the difference;

sentences.zh: 在春分之宿後，入黃道內，秋分之宿後，出黃道外：皆以差為減。

translations.literal: After spring equinox's lodge enter inside Yellow Path; after autumn equinox's lodge exit outside Yellow Path—all take difference as subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After the spring-equinox lodge, entering within, and after the autumn-equinox lodge, exiting without—all subtract the difference.

sentences.zh: 四約泛差，以黃道差減之，為赤道差。

translations.literal: Quarter-reduce general difference; subtract Yellow Path difference—for Red Path difference.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the general difference by one quarter and subtract the ecliptic difference to obtain the equatorial difference.

sentences.zh: 正交、中交前後各九限，皆以差為加。

translations.literal: Rectified crossing and median crossing before and after nine limits each—all take difference as add.
translations.idiomatic: For nine limits around rectified and median crossing, always add the difference.

sentences.zh: 半交前後各九限，皆以差為減。

translations.literal: Half-crossing before and after nine limits each—all take difference as subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For nine limits around half crossing, always subtract the difference.

sentences.zh: 以黃赤二差加減黃道，為九道宿次；

translations.literal: With Yellow and Red two differences add and subtract Yellow Path—for nine paths' lodge sequence;
translations.idiomatic: Apply the two ecliptic and equatorial differences to the ecliptic to obtain the nine-path lodge sequence;

translations.literal: From its fractional parts derive slight, great, and half numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Express the fractional parts as slight, great, and half.

sentences.zh: 八節各九道，七十二道周焉。

translations.literal: Eight nodes each nine paths; seventy-two paths complete the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Eight nodal points times nine paths yield seventy-two paths completing the cycle.

translations.literal: Nine paths' rectified-crossing lunar degree
translations.idiomatic: Lunar position on the nine paths at rectified crossing

translations.literal: Set moon's departure rectified-crossing Yellow Path lodge degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Set the moon's ecliptic lodge position at rectified crossing;

sentences.zh: 各以所入限率乘之，亦乘其分，經法約之，為泛差。

translations.literal: Each multiplies by limit rate entered; also multiply its fractional parts; reduce by canonical method—for general difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the entered limit rate and its fractional parts, reduce by the canonical method, to obtain the general difference.

sentences.zh: 用求黃赤二差，以加減之，即月離正交九道宿度也。

translations.literal: Use to seek Yellow and Red two differences; add and subtract—this is moon's departure rectified-crossing nine paths' lodge degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Derive the ecliptic and equatorial differences and apply them to obtain the moon's nine-path lodge position at rectified crossing.

translations.literal: ◎ Nine paths' new-moon lunar degree
translations.idiomatic: ◎ New-moon lunar position on the nine paths

sentences.zh: 置月離正交九道宿度，以入交度加之，命以九道宿次，即其朔加時月離九道宿度也。

translations.literal: Set moon's departure rectified-crossing nine paths' lodge degrees; add entering-crossing degrees; count by nine paths' lodge sequence—this is its new moon added-time moon's departure nine paths' lodge degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Set the moon's nine-path position at rectified crossing, add crossing-entry degrees, and count through the nine-path sequence for the lunar nine-path position at new-moon added time.

translations.literal: ◎ Nine paths' full-moon lunar degree
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Full-moon lunar position on the nine paths

sentences.zh: 置朔望加時日相距之度，以軌中加之，為加時象積。

translations.literal: Set new moon and full moon added-time sun's mutual distance degrees; add track median—for added-time image accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar separation at new- and full-moon added time, add track median, to obtain the added-time image accumulation.

sentences.zh: 用加其朔九道月度，命以其道宿次，既所求也。

translations.literal: Use to add to its new moon nine paths' lunar degree; count by that path's lodge sequence—this is already what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Add this to the new-moon nine-path lunar position and count through that path's lodge sequence to obtain the result.

translations.literal: From full moon project new moon—it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Project backward from full moon to new moon by the same method.

translations.literal: ◎ Moon's departure noon-center entering calendar
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Lunar departure: noon calendar entry

sentences.zh: 置朔望月離入歷，加半統，減去定分，各以日躔月離朓朒定數，朓減、朒加之，即所求也。

translations.literal: Set new moon and full moon moon's departure entry calendar; add half comprehensive; subtract fixed fractional parts; each with sun's motion and moon's departure tiao-tuo fixed number, tiao subtract and tuo add—this is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Set lunar calendar entries for new and full moon, add half the comprehensive method and subtract fixed fractional parts, then adjust with fixed solar and lunar elongation—subtract for waning, add for waxing—to obtain the result.

translations.literal: ◎ Dawn and dusk lunar degrees
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Dawn and dusk lunar positions

sentences.zh: 置其日晨昏分，以定分減之，為前；

translations.literal: Set that day's dawn and dusk fractional parts; subtract fixed fractional parts—for before;
translations.idiomatic: Set that day's dawn and dusk fractional parts and subtract the fixed parts to obtain the before fraction;

translations.literal: if insufficient, return subtract—for after.
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient, reverse the subtraction to obtain the after fraction.

sentences.zh: 用乘其日離程，統法而一，滿經法為度，為晨昏前後度。

translations.literal: Use to multiply that day's departure procedure; comprehensive method to one; filling canonical method for degrees—for dawn and dusk before and after degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by that day's departure procedure, divide by the comprehensive method, and convert fractions filling the canonical method into degrees for dawn and dusk offsets.

sentences.zh: 前加、後減加時月，為晨昏月度。

translations.literal: before add, after subtract from added-time moon—for dawn and dusk lunar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: add for before and subtract for after from the added-time lunar position to obtain dawn and dusk lunar positions.

translations.literal: Dawn and dusk image accumulation
translations.idiomatic: Image accumulation at dawn and dusk

sentences.zh: 置加時象積，以前象前後度，前減、後加，又以後象前後度，前加、後減之，即所求也。

translations.literal: Set added-time image accumulation; with former image before-after degrees, before subtract and after add; again with latter image before-after degrees, before add and after subtract—this is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Set the added-time image accumulation, apply the prior image's before-after degrees (subtract before, add after), then the latter image's degrees (add before, subtract after), to obtain the result.

translations.literal: ◎ Each day's dawn and dusk lunar degrees
translations.idiomatic: ◎ Daily dawn and dusk lunar positions

sentences.zh: 累計距後象離度，以減晨昏象積，為加；

translations.literal: Accumulate and count distance-from following image departure degrees; subtract from dawn-dusk image accumulation—for add;
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate departure degrees from the following image and subtract from the dawn-dusk image accumulation for addition;

translations.literal: if insufficient, counter subtract—for subtract.
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient, reverse the subtraction for subtraction.

sentences.zh: 以距後象日數除之，用加減每日離度，為定度。

translations.literal: Divide by following image's day count; use to add and subtract each day's departure degrees—for fixed degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the days to the following image and apply to adjust each day's departure degrees to obtain fixed degrees.

sentences.zh: 累加晨昏月度，命以九道宿次，即所求。

translations.literal: Add cumulatively dawn and dusk lunar degrees; count by nine paths' lodge sequence—this is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Add dawn and dusk lunar positions cumulatively and count through the nine-path lodge sequence to obtain the result.

translations.literal: Moon's distance-from Yellow Path degrees
translations.idiomatic: Lunar latitude relative to the ecliptic

translations.literal: Set entering-crossing fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed crossing day.

translations.literal: Below crossing median, moon proceeds yang path;
translations.idiomatic: Below the crossing median, the moon travels the yang path;

sentences.zh: 以上，去之，月行陰道：皆以經法通之。

translations.literal: above it, remove it—moon proceeds yin path: all extend through canonical method.
translations.idiomatic: above it, subtract to obtain the yin path—extend both through the canonical method.

sentences.zh: 用減九百八十，余以乘之，五百五十六而一，為分；

translations.literal: Use to subtract nine hundred eighty; remainder multiply it; five hundred fifty-six to one—for fractional parts;
translations.idiomatic: subtract from 980, multiply the remainder, and divide by 556 for fractional parts;

translations.literal: filling canonical method for degrees.
translations.idiomatic: and convert to degrees when the canonical method is filled.

translations.literal: proceeding yang path, outside Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: on the yang path, outside the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 行陰道，在黃道內，即所求月去黃道內外度也。

translations.literal: proceeding yin path, inside Yellow Path—this is the sought moon's distance-from Yellow Path inside-outside degrees.
translations.idiomatic: on the yin path, inside the ecliptic—the lunar latitude sought.

translations.literal: Sun and moon eclipse limits
translations.idiomatic: Solar and lunar eclipse limits

translations.literal: Set fixed crossing proceeding yin-yang path day.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed day on the yin or yang crossing path.

translations.literal: Below half crossing median, this is after crossing;
translations.idiomatic: Below half the crossing median counts as after crossing;

sentences.zh: 以上，用減交中，為交前：皆以統法通之，為距交分。

translations.literal: above it, use to subtract crossing median for before crossing: all extend through comprehensive method—for distance-from-crossing fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: above, subtract from the crossing median for before crossing—extend both through the comprehensive method as distance-from-crossing parts.

sentences.zh: 朔視距交分，陽道四千二百一十九、陰道一萬三百八十三以下，日入食限。

translations.literal: New moon views distance-from-crossing fractional parts; yang path four thousand two hundred nineteen and yin path ten thousand three hundred eighty-three and below—sun enters eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: At new moon, if distance-from-crossing parts are 4,219 or less on the yang path or 10,383 or less on the yin path, a solar eclipse is possible.

sentences.zh: 望視距交分陰陽道皆六千九百九十五以下，月入蝕限。

translations.literal: Full moon views distance-from-crossing fractional parts; yin and yang paths both six thousand nine hundred ninety-five and below—moon enters eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: At full moon, if distance-from-crossing parts are 6,995 or less on either path, a lunar eclipse is possible.

translations.literal: Sun and moon eclipse maximum added-time fixed fractional parts
translations.idiomatic: Fixed fractional parts for eclipse maximum time

translations.literal: Set new moon fixed fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed fractional parts for new moon.

translations.literal: Above half comprehensive, subtract half comprehensive;
translations.idiomatic: If above half the comprehensive method, subtract half the comprehensive method;

sentences.zh: 半統以下，用減半統：為距午分。

translations.literal: below half comprehensive, use to subtract half comprehensive—for distance-from-noon fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: if below, subtract from half the comprehensive method to obtain distance-from-noon parts.

translations.literal: Multiply by eleven; canonical method to one.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by eleven and divide by the canonical method.

translations.literal: Below half comprehensive, subtract half comprehensive; above, add to new moon fixed fractional parts—for solar eclipse added-time fixed fractional parts.
translations.idiomatic: If below half the comprehensive method, subtract it; if above, add to the new-moon fixed parts—to obtain fixed fractional parts for solar-eclipse added time.

sentences.zh: 以上，以加朔定分：為日食加時定分。

translations.literal: If above, add the new-moon fixed fraction: this is the solar eclipse added-time fixed fraction.
translations.idiomatic: When the value lies above [half comprehensive], add the new-moon fixed fraction to obtain the fixed fraction for the hour of greatest solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 望以其日晨分與一千六百二十相減，余以二百四十五乘之，三百一十三而一；

translations.literal: At full moon, subtract that day's morning fraction from 1,620; multiply the remainder by 245 and divide by 313;
translations.idiomatic: For full moon, subtract the day's morning fraction from 1,620, multiply the remainder by 245, and divide by 313;

sentences.zh: 用減二百四十五，余以損益望定分，為月食加時定分。

translations.literal: use it to subtract from 245; with the remainder increase or decrease the full-moon fixed fraction—this is the lunar eclipse added-time fixed fraction.
translations.idiomatic: subtract that from 245, then add or subtract the remainder to the full-moon fixed fraction to obtain the fixed fraction for the hour of greatest lunar eclipse.

translations.literal: Solar eclipse constant standard
translations.idiomatic: Constant standard for solar eclipses

translations.literal: Set the median standard;
translations.idiomatic: Place the median standard;

sentences.zh: 與其日赤道內外數相乘，二千五百一十三除，為黃道出入食差。

translations.literal: multiply it by that day's Red Path inner-or-outer number, divide by 2,513, and obtain the Yellow Path in-out eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: multiply it by the day's equatorial inner-or-outer index, divide by 2,513, and obtain the ecliptic ingress–egress eclipse correction.

sentences.zh: 以距午分減半晝分以乘之，半晝分而一；

translations.literal: subtract the distance-from-noon fraction from half the daytime fraction and multiply; divide by half the daytime fraction;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by (half daytime fraction minus distance-from-noon fraction), then divide by half the daytime fraction;

sentences.zh: 赤道內以減、赤道外以加中準，為日食常準。

translations.literal: within the Red Path subtract, outside the Red Path add to the median standard—this is the solar eclipse constant standard.
translations.idiomatic: subtract from the median standard when inside the equator, add when outside—this yields the solar eclipse constant standard.

translations.literal: Solar eclipse fixed standard
translations.idiomatic: Fixed standard for solar eclipses

sentences.zh: 置日躔入歷，以經法通之，三千二百八十七以下，用減三千二百八十七，為二至後；

translations.literal: Set the sun's motion entry into the circuit and pass it through the canonical method; if below 3,287, use it to subtract from 3,287—this is after the two solstices;
translations.idiomatic: Set solar motion's circuit entry, convert by the canonical method; if below 3,287, subtract from 3,287—this is post-solstitial;

sentences.zh: 以上，減去三千二百八十七，為二分前。

translations.literal: if above, subtract 3,287—this is before the two equinoxes.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract 3,287—this is pre-equinoxial.

sentences.zh: 六千五百七十四以上，用減九千八百六十一，為二分後；

translations.literal: If above 6,574, use it to subtract from 9,861—this is after the two equinoxes;
translations.idiomatic: If above 6,574, subtract from 9,861—this is post-equinoxial;

sentences.zh: 以上，減去九千八百六十一，為二至前。

translations.literal: if above, subtract 9,861—this is before the two solstices.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract 9,861—this is pre-solstitial.

sentences.zh: 各三約之，二至前後用減、二分前後用加二千七百七十二，為黃道斜正食差。

translations.literal: In each case divide by three; before the two solstices subtract, before and after the two equinoxes add 2,772—this is the Yellow Path oblique-and-direct eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide each by three; subtract for solstitial intervals, add 2,772 for equinoctial intervals—this is the ecliptic obliquity eclipse correction.

sentences.zh: 以距午分乘之，半晝分而一，以加常準，為定準。

translations.literal: Multiply by the distance-from-noon fraction, divide by half the daytime fraction, and add to the constant standard—this is the fixed standard.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by distance-from-noon, divide by half daytime, add to the constant standard to obtain the fixed standard.

translations.literal: Solar eclipse magnitude
translations.idiomatic: Magnitude of solar eclipse

sentences.zh: 以定準加中限，為陰道定準；

translations.literal: Add the fixed standard to the median limit—this is the yin path fixed standard;
translations.idiomatic: Add the fixed standard to the median limit to obtain the yin-path fixed standard;

translations.literal: subtract the median limit—this is the yang path fixed limit.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the median limit to obtain the yang-path fixed limit.

sentences.zh: 不足減者，反減之，為限外分。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, reverse-subtract—this is the outside-limit fraction.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction is impossible, subtract in reverse—this is the beyond-limit fraction.

sentences.zh: 視陰道距交分，定準以上，定限以下，為陰道食；

translations.literal: Observe the yin path's distance-from-crossing fraction: if the fixed standard is above and the fixed limit below, it is a yin-path eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: For yin-path distance-from-crossing: when fixed standard exceeds and fixed limit is not exceeded, a yin-path eclipse applies;

sentences.zh: 即置定限，以距交分減之，為距食分。

translations.literal: then set the fixed limit, subtract the distance-from-crossing fraction—this is the distance-from-eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: set the fixed limit and subtract distance-from-crossing to obtain distance-from-eclipse.

sentences.zh: 定準以下，雖曰陰道，亦為陽道食；

translations.literal: Below the fixed standard, though called yin path, it is still a yang-path eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: Below the fixed standard, though nominally yin-path, treat as yang-path eclipse;

sentences.zh: 即加陽道定限，為距食分。

translations.literal: then add the yang path fixed limit—this is the distance-from-eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: add the yang-path fixed limit to obtain distance-from-eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其有限外分者，即減去限外分，為距食分。

translations.literal: If there is an outside-limit fraction, subtract the outside-limit fraction—this is the distance-from-eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: If a beyond-limit fraction exists, subtract it to obtain distance-from-eclipse.

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction fails, no eclipse occurs.

sentences.zh: 其陽道距交分，定限以下，為入定食限；

translations.literal: For yang-path distance-from-crossing fraction, if below the fixed limit, it enters the fixed eclipse limit;
translations.idiomatic: For yang-path distance-from-crossing below the fixed limit, the eclipse enters the fixed limit;

sentences.zh: 即用減陽道定限，為距食分。

translations.literal: then use it to subtract from the yang path fixed limit—this is the distance-from-eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: subtract it from the yang-path fixed limit to obtain distance-from-eclipse.

sentences.zh: 各置距食分，皆以四百七十八除，為日食之大分；

translations.literal: In each case set the distance-from-eclipse fraction and divide all by 478—this is the solar eclipse great fraction;
translations.idiomatic: Set each distance-from-eclipse fraction and divide by 478 to obtain the solar eclipse major fraction;

translations.literal: the remainder is the small fraction.
translations.idiomatic: the remainder is the minor fraction.

translations.literal: Name the great fraction with ten as limit;
translations.idiomatic: Express the major fraction in tenths;

translations.literal: name the small fraction with half and strong-weak.
translations.idiomatic: express the minor fraction in halves and strong/weak gradations.

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse magnitude
translations.idiomatic: Magnitude of lunar eclipse

sentences.zh: 視距交分，中準以下，皆既；

translations.literal: Observe the distance-from-crossing fraction: at the median standard and below, all are total;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect distance-from-crossing: at or below the median standard, the eclipse is total;

sentences.zh: 以上，用減食限，為距食分。

translations.literal: above, use it to subtract from the eclipse limit—this is the distance-from-eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: above that, subtract from the eclipse limit to obtain distance-from-eclipse.

sentences.zh: 置之，以五百二十六除，為月食之大分；

translations.literal: Set it and divide by 526—this is the lunar eclipse great fraction;
translations.idiomatic: Set the value and divide by 526 for the lunar eclipse major fraction;

translations.literal: the remainder is the small fraction.
translations.idiomatic: the remainder is the minor fraction.

translations.literal: Name the great fraction with ten as limit;
translations.idiomatic: Express the major fraction in tenths;

translations.literal: name the small fraction with half and strong-weak.
